[[File:KuBakai.png|thumb|250px|[[Ku'Bakai]], a [[Color/Legends|blue]] giant]]
A '''blue giant''' was a massive [[Star/Legends|star]] that had progressed past the main sequence. [[Ku'Bakai]] was a [[Color/Legends|blue]] giant. The [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Jilrua]] [[Orbit/Legends|orbited]] a blue giant star.<ref name="TEA">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref>
